Dragons

Dragons

Dragons, dragon turtles, and great serpents. Most are apex threats — encounters are survival problems, not fights.

Dragon Turtles

  • Ancient Dragon Turtle — Mythic deep-water predator known for boiling seas and scalding steam breath; found in the Drowned Maw and around Keth-Naar
  • Dragon Turtle — Large enough to break a working boat; lurks at the edge of the Sunken Crown blue hole and eastern Outer Reach
  • Young Dragon Turtle — Dangerous enough to capsize small vessels; found where reef shallows give way to deep water
  • Dragon Turtle Wyrmling — Still large enough to wreck a skiff; sightings cluster around the outer beaches of the Sunken Crown

Sea Serpents

  • Ancient Sea Serpent — Cold-current predator that moves against the wind; haunts the deep lanes of the Outer Reach
  • Young Sea Serpent — Follows warm currents through the Outer Reach and along the Tail’s shelf edge

True Dragons

  • Ancient Gold Dragon — The oldest and most powerful of the metallic dragons; a legendary coastal presence
  • Adult Gold Dragon — Commanding metallic dragon of coastal and island territories
  • Ancient Bronze Dragon — Elder coastal metallic dragon; watches the Shelfworks and Drowned Maw from the western shelf
  • Adult Bronze Dragon — The Stormwarden of the Galewall; appears during the worst crossings in humanoid form
  • Ancient Black Dragon — The reason Aruhe is avoided; old enough to have dissolved the island’s terraces from the base up
  • Adult Black Dragon — Swamp and mangrove predator of the Doldrums; a becalmed ship is close to ideal hunting
  • Ancient Blue Dragon — Laired in the Redwind Isles of the Outer Reach; has made the islands uninhabitable without needing to explain itself
  • Adult Blue Dragon — Taxes Crown Islands shipping through the Greyteeth; the Crown’s arrangement with it is unacknowledged but functional
  • Ancient Green Dragon — Old-growth forest predator; master manipulator with poison breath and a taste for long schemes
  • Adult Green Dragon — Forest dragon; hunts the dense interior canopy of large islands
